placements.why: No strata exist yet. The envelope's content is entirely about what an e2e test suite asserts as system behavior (enrollment-on-save) and a probe artifact whose sole purpose is to carry that assertion — this is squarely organizational-proof territory (verification/evidence), not opportunity, strategy, product, architecture, organization, templates, or calibration content. Minting Proof as the top-level strata category this content calls for, per the ratified taxonomy name, with no forced parent.
placements.title: Automated test suites become the arbiter of asserted system behavior
placements.frame: Does this content report what an automated suite verifies or enforces about the system, rather than a human argument or design intent?

placements.title: System behavior is established by what the e2e suite asserts, not by declared design intent
placements.frame: What behavioral rule does the e2e suite assert here, and does the artifact exist only to carry that assertion forward as evidence?
placements.why: src-1 states the decision-grain claim that the e2e suite asserts a specific enrollment rule (saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer); src-2 explicitly frames the entire probe memory's existence as solely a carrier for that assertion. Together these are not a one-time fact but a recurring thematic subject — future envelopes will keep feeding assertions the e2e suite makes about system behavior, and probes minted purely to carry such assertions — which the grain test admits as a leaf, nested under the freshly minted Proof strata since no existing structure holds it.
